newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: American tourist killed in robbery in Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: American tourist killed in robbery in Cambodia.

text.p: An American tourist was shot and killed during an attempted robbery in Phnom Penh, an official at the U.S. Embassy said on Thursday.
The man was shot in a street in Phnom Penh on Wednesday night, the embassy official said.
"It was a criminal incident...there were no political overtones," the official said, but declined to release the victim's name or give any further details.
There have been numerous incidents of muggers robbing foreigners on Phnom Penh streets at night in recent months but this was the first time a victim was killed.
The U.S. Embassy issues regular warnings about the dangers of travelling in the city at night.
